baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَنَّاتٍ and أَلْفَافًا jointly describe plural gardens whose own growth hides and binds their interior.
baseline_models.mechanism: Trees make the garden by covering its space, while vigorous plants interweave across garden boundaries. Density is therefore a self-producing enclosure, not merely a high plant count.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered enclosure supplies the concrete garden and makes canopy-created concealment part of its form.
Thick, vigorous, intertwined growth supplies the process by which the enclosure becomes dense.
Intertwined vegetation turns separate stems and gardens into a mutually folded growth mass.

changed_reading.before: Many lush gardens stand side by side.
changed_reading.after: The gardens are a self-concealing living mass: growth crosses internal boundaries until the vegetation itself makes the enclosure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The concealment range of جَنَّاتٍ and the physical wrapping range of أَلْفَافًا overlap in the two-word focus phrase.
baseline_models.mechanism: One root supplies a cover that protects what lies within; the other supplies layers wrapped around layers. The garden can therefore function as an inhabitable refuge whose abundance also shelters.

activation_trace.role: Covering and concealment supply an interior screened from direct perception.
The protective cover turns concealment into a shielding function rather than visual density alone.
Wrapping one layer around another supplies the spatial operation that builds the refuge.

changed_reading.before: The adjective only reports dense foliage.
changed_reading.after: The foliage wraps an interior and acts as a layered protective habitat.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: Plural جَنَّاتٍ can be treated as a mass, while one branch of أَلْفَافًا explicitly gathers unlike constituents into one group.
baseline_models.mechanism: Overlapping boundaries allow distinct plots, species, and layers to remain multiple while behaving as one collective body. The unity is compositional rather than uniform.

activation_trace.role: The dark mass or body of a multitude supplies a collective silhouette for the plural gardens.
A mixed gathering treated as one supplies heterogeneous membership without erasing the members.

changed_reading.before: The verse presents several similar gardens.
changed_reading.after: The verse presents a heterogeneous ecology whose unlike members overlap into one corporate mass.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: جَنَّاتٍ carries branches of life hidden in a womb and of the dead hidden in a grave, while أَلْفَافًا can denote enveloping or shrouding.
baseline_models.mechanism: The same layered cover can hold life before appearance or a body after disappearance. A garden may thus image concealed potential held beneath or within a wrapping, not only visible vegetation.

activation_trace.role: The fetus hidden in the womb supplies a model of living potential enclosed before emergence.
Burial and shrouding supply the inverse state of a body concealed after visible life.
Physical enveloping, including shrouding, supplies the common container for gestation and burial.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are fully manifest growth.
changed_reading.after: Their visible wrapping hints at an unseen reserve in which life can be held before emergence and after burial.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated making, paired constituents, construction by joining parts, and later correspondence revise the interwoven garden from wild congestion into fitted structure. Its density behaves like living joinery: distinct units are placed into relations that stabilize the whole.

activation_trace.role: Vigorous intertwined growth supplies the living material that the constructive pattern organizes.
Intertwined vegetation supplies physical joining across adjacent plants and plots.
The mixed gathering preserves constituent difference inside the joined whole.
Rendering something into a state supplies intentional arrangement rather than accidental density.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies relational units from which the larger ecology is composed.
Building by joining parts supplies the structural analogy for vegetation knitted into a stable whole.
Mutual fit and correspondence sharpen interlacing into coordinated relation rather than undifferentiated mixture.

structural_cues: 78:6-13 repeatedly moves through making, pairing, pegging, and building before the rain-to-growth sequence.
The focus construction keeps plurality in جَنَّاتٍ while أَلْفَافًا predicates their binding together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated acts of arrangement, paired life, joined construction, and fit; I infer that this constructive grammar continues into the final interwoven growth. A live alternative is that these are independent favors and أَلْفَافًا marks only visual thickness.

changed_reading.before: Dense gardens are a luxuriant but largely unordered mass.
changed_reading.after: Dense gardens are living construction: unlike, paired units fit and overlap into a stable ecological structure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Night covers the perceptible world and is then explicitly cast as clothing. That earlier cover operation strengthens the two focus roots as a second garment, now made of vegetation and wrapped around a habitable interior.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the screened interior of the vegetal garment.
Protective covering makes the garden-garment shelter as well as hide.
Layering one thing around another supplies the garment's wrapping action.
Night and its darkness supply a world-scale cover parallel to the garden's canopy.
Covering with clothing makes the earlier night image an explicit model for protective envelopment.

structural_cues: 78:10 predicates clothing of night, and 78:16 closes the following habitat-and-provision sequence with a doubly covering phrase.
Both focus roots independently support enclosure, so the garment analogy does not rest on context alone.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies night, clothing, and two focus roots of concealment and wrapping; I infer that the same cover function recurs in a living material. A live alternative is that night-as-clothing and dense gardens are separate sensory images.

changed_reading.after: The gardens clothe space with a layered living cover that screens and protects what lies within.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pressure yields water, water pours, and hidden seed is brought outward as growth. The interwoven gardens become the terminal release-state of that hydraulic chain: dispersed hidden units emerge, multiply, and finally close ranks into cover.

activation_trace.role: Thick vigorous growth supplies the accumulating output of the release sequence.
Intertwining supplies the final state in which separate emergent plants become continuous cover.
Pressure until liquid is expressed supplies the initiating conversion from contained potential to flow.
Conveying water by irrigation supplies the transport that reaches the hidden seed.
Pouring and outflow supply the force and abundance of the water transfer.
Bringing a thing out of concealment supplies the directional transition from latent seed to visible growth.
The seed that germinates supplies the discrete hidden unit released by water.
Vegetation emerging from earth supplies the intermediate state before growth thickens into gardens.

structural_cues: The purpose construction in 78:15 links the water of 78:14 to bringing out seed, vegetation, and the coordinated object continued in 78:16.
The sequence moves from contained water to flow, emergence, and finally spatial density.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pressure, poured water, an explicit purpose clause, seed, and emergence; I infer the additional arrow from many emerged plants to a boundary-closing woven habitat. A live alternative is that gardens are simply one more product in a list, without emphasis on the release-to-binding transition.

changed_reading.before: The gardens are a static final item among rain's products.
changed_reading.after: They are the visible completion of a pressure-flow-emergence system, where hidden seeds become a continuous interlocked cover.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus presents maximum binding immediately before the named day of separation; the sky then opens and mountains are displaced into apparent water. The gardens become a threshold image of the current world's cohesion just before its boundaries and anchors are undone.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered enclosure supplies a bounded place whose coherence can later be contrasted with opened structures.
Intertwining supplies the strongest local image of things held together before the reversal.
Separating one thing from another and exposing the boundary supplies the operation opposite to interweaving.
Opening what was closed supplies the first large-scale reversal of enclosure.
Removal and displacement supply the loss of the terrain's fixed anchors.
A mirage that only appears to be water supplies the dissolution of solidity into unstable appearance.

structural_cues: 78:16 is the final creation-and-provision image, and 78:17 immediately names the day of separation.
The passive transformations of 78:19-20 open the sky and remove the mountains that 78:7 and 78:12 had presented as fixed structure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an immediate bound-versus-separated sequence followed by opened and displaced structures; I infer that the focus garden marks the last concentrated cohesion before cosmic disassembly. A live alternative is a simple section break with no threshold force in the garden image.

changed_reading.before: Interweaving only intensifies the abundance of the creation catalogue.
changed_reading.after: Interweaving is the catalogue's final image of cohesion, placed at the edge of a day that separates, opens, and displaces the created order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Seed exits concealment as vegetation, while the same growth root can describe human raising; later standing and the final wish for dust activate the focus branches of womb, burial, and wrapping. The garden becomes a material rehearsal of life retained invisibly and brought back out.

activation_trace.role: Life hidden in a womb supplies the pre-emergent pole of the return mechanism.
Burial and shrouding supply the post-disappearance pole from which return can be imagined.
Enveloping supplies the shared material condition of gestation, seed-cover, and shroud.
Bringing the hidden outward supplies the transition from retained life to manifest life.
The germinating seed supplies a concrete small body whose life persists under cover.
Human growth and raising within the plant root's range supplies the bridge from botanical emergence to human return.
Resurrection and rising supply the later human realization of emergence from concealment.
Earth and dust supply the material that can conceal seed or body and from which visible growth arises.

structural_cues: 78:14-16 stages water bringing concealed seed into abundant visible life, while 78:38-40 stages standing, judgment, and a final desire to be dust.
The focus sits at the visible completion of the first emergence arc but contains lexical branches for both womb and grave.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies germinating seed, emergence, a human-growth branch, resurrection, and dust; I infer that botanical emergence offers an analogy for human return and that the focus garden displays its completed form. A live alternative is that the agricultural and resurrection sequences remain parallel only at a broad thematic level.

changed_reading.before: The wrapped-latency reading is an isolated lexical possibility inside the focus roots.
changed_reading.after: The gardens enact a cycle of retained and returned life: what is wrapped in earth can emerge, thicken, disappear, and stand forth again.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later sequence joins protected people, deliverance, enclosed gardens, fruit, and recompense. That sequence revises the focus's protective wrapping into an earthly preview of a later rewarded enclosure rather than shelter as a purely physical property.

activation_trace.role: The tree-covered garden supplies the material form repeated by the later reward garden.
Protective covering supplies the refuge function that later protection language makes ethically charged.
Layered wrapping supplies an enveloping interior rather than an exposed patch of produce.
Deflecting harm through protection activates the shielding branch already present in جَنَّاتٍ.
Attaining good and escape supplies the result achieved by entering the protected enclosure.
A bounded garden supplies a later explicit enclosure corresponding to the focus garden's self-covering form.
Grapes supply concrete fruit within the later enclosure and turn generic abundance into provision.
Answering action with recompense supplies the later garden's distributive and ethical function.

structural_cues: 78:14-16 ends the earthly rain sequence in gardens, while 78:31-36 begins deliverance with enclosed gardens, fruit, and recompense.
The two garden sequences share enclosure and provision but occupy different temporal and ethical registers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an earthly garden endpoint and a later protected, fruitful recompense; I infer that the first materially previews the second. A live alternative is that the two garden registers are independent and only share ordinary imagery.

changed_reading.before: The focus gardens are only present-world agricultural provision.
changed_reading.after: Their self-covering abundance also previews a later enclosure where protection, deliverance, fruit, and recompense converge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates a seed-covering branch from the closing كَافِر rather than treating that branch as the surface denotation. It remains valid as a lexical echo because the packet supplies that branch, seed, dust, and two focus roots of concealment and wrapping. Downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory loop and must not replace the moral sense of كَافِر with 'sower' or claim an explicit equation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The garden noun supplies concealment and tree-cover, while أَلْفَافًا supplies wrapping; together they can hold the image of seed covered in earth until it becomes a garden.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the state shared by buried seed and the hidden interior of a garden.
The tree-covered garden supplies the manifest result that can grow from what was covered.
Wrapping supplies the material action of placing cover around hidden potential.
The germinating seed supplies the concealed object that can become the focus garden.
Covering seed supplies the unexpected lexical action that loops the closing figure back toward germination.
Dust and earth supply both the requested final state and the medium that covers seed.

changed_reading.before: The closing unbeliever and dust are wholly external to the earlier garden image.
changed_reading.after: At the level of contained lexical echo, the seed-coverer who wishes for dust closes a ring back to gardens as life emerging from what earth conceals.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps botanical density onto social assembly. It remains anchored in explicit focus branches for a dark multitude and a mixed gathering, which later groups and ranks reactivate. Downstream prose should qualify it as a formal spatial analogy, not claim that جَنَّاتٍ denotes people.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The plural gardens form one mass through the crowd-like branch of ج ن ن and the mixed-gathering branch of ل ف ف.

activation_trace.role: A dark mass of people supplies a crowd silhouette for the dense garden canopy.
Unlike groups gathered as one supply the compositional logic shared by ecology and assembly.
Groups of people arriving together reactivate the mixed collective latent in أَلْفَافًا.
Alignment on an even line supplies an ordered counterpart to the garden's organic crowding.

changed_reading.before: The gardens' massing is exclusively botanical.
changed_reading.after: Their mixed, overlapping body also offers a spatial prototype for later collectives assembled in groups and ranks.

strongest_changes: The rain sequence converted static lushness into the terminal release-state of a pressure, flow, seed, emergence, and interlocking-growth system.
The immediate move from أَلْفَافًا to the day of separation recast the focus as the created order's last image of cohesion before opening and displacement.
The later protected and recompensed gardens revised botanical cover into a possible present-world preview of refuge.
Seed, human growth, resurrection, and dust strengthened the exploratory womb-and-shroud branches into a return mechanism.
summary.what_was_special: The two focus roots independently double concealment and interlacing, so the same compact phrase could remain anchored while context moved it through hydraulic, architectural, protective, temporal, generative, and collective mechanisms.
remaining_uncertainties: It remains uncertain how much of the protective and garment force belongs to the focus construction rather than to branch-level resonance sharpened by 78:10 and 78:31-32.
The earthly and rewarded garden sequences may be deliberate preview and fulfillment, or simply two distinct uses of familiar abundance imagery.
The germination-return, seed-coverer, and assembled-crowd readings are traceable but remain exploratory cross-domain analogies rather than settled compositional readings.
